This '''species''' of bipedal [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]] lived on a [[Unidentified planet (purple-faced species)|planet]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]], near the border of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] space. Their face was split down the middle, flaring out in two flaps over a mouth full of sharp white teeth. They wore [[Goggles/Legends|goggles]] over their two [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="Flash">[[Knights of the Old Republic 8|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 8]]</ref>

Their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] was conquered by [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] forces under control of [[Rohlan Dyre]], a [[Mandalorian Crusaders|Mandalorian Crusader]] who was trying to escape the army so as to discover the true motivation of the Mandalorian expansion. He killed many of the species' blue uniformed military while making his escape.<ref name="Flash" /> A member of this species was also sighted on the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] homeworld of [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] in [[3993 BBY]].<ref name="S&L" />

==Behind the scenes==
This species was created by [[Dustin Weaver]] in the comic ''Shadows and Light'', published in ''[[Star Wars Tales 23|Tales 23]]'' in [[May]] [[2005]]. Only one member of the species was seen, as this only on the very edge of one panel. When Weaver later worked on ''Star Wars Knights of the Old Republic'' in [[September]] [[2006]], he drew this species being conquered by the Mandalorians, as a fun tie in to his earlier work.<ref name="Weaver">{{DHBoards|subdomain=www|url=boards/viewtopic.php?t=10089&postdays=0&postorder=asc&start=60|thread=KNIGHTS of the OLD REPUBLIC #8 - The doctor will see you now|user=Dustin Weaver|date=2006-10-14|time=2:40}}</ref>
